summaries.title: Emu: Enhancing Image Generation Models Using Photogenic Needles in a Haystack
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Emu** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we propose quality-tuning to effectively guide a pre-trained model to exclusively generate highly visually appealing images, while maintaining generality...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Compared to the state-of-the-art SDXLv1.0, Emu is preferred 68.4% and 71.3% of the time on visual appeal on the standard PartiPrompts and our Open User Input...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **82.9%, 68.4%, 71.3%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The resulting model, Emu, achieves a win rate of 82.9% compared with its pre-trained only counterpart；In addition, we show that quality-tuning is a generic approach that is also effective for other architectures,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 34 赞），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)、图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Finite Scalar Quantization: VQ-VAE Made Simple
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」痛点，作者围绕 **Finite Scalar Quantization** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉生成与世界模型（Vision & World），并引入 to replace vector quantization (VQ) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We propose to replace vector quantization (VQ) in the latent representation of VQ-VAEs with a simple scheme termed finite scalar quantization (FSQ), where we project the VAE...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：By appropriately choosing the number of dimensions and values each dimension can take, we obtain the same codebook size as in VQ。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We emphasize that FSQ does not suffer from codebook collapse and does not need the complex machinery employed in VQ (commitment losses, codebook reseeding, code splitting, entropy...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 24 赞），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Low-rank Adaptation of Large Language Model Rescoring for Parameter-Efficient Speech Recognition

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **LibriSpeech**。实验设计与验证细节：Here we present a method based on low-rank decomposition to train a rescoring BERT model and adapt it to new domains using only a fraction (0.08%) of...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **0.08%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Here we present a method based on low-rank decomposition to train a rescoring BERT model and adapt it to new domains using only a fraction (0.08%) of the pretrained parameters）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 23 赞），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: VPA: Fully Test-Time Visual Prompt Adaptation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **VPA** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model (VLM)）、分布外泛化（Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Generalization）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization），并引入 Visual Prompt Adaptation (VPA) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this work, we present Visual Prompt Adaptation (VPA), the first framework that generalizes visual prompting with test-time adaptation。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this work, we present Visual Prompt Adaptation (VPA), the first framework that generalizes visual prompting with test-time adaptation。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **3.3%, 6.5%, 5.2%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experimental results reveal that VPA effectively enhances OOD generalization by 3.3% across various models,...；Finally, we demonstrate that VPA also boosts domain adaptation performance by relatively 5.2%）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 5 赞），本工作为突破 **测试时计算扩展与高效思考 (TTC & Hybrid)、视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
